summary: A recipient unexpectedly received 15000 USDT after a seller claimed to have pasted the wrong wallet address and requested the funds be returned to a different address while offering a reward. The unusual return request raised concerns that the transfer was part of a social engineering scam.
user_mistake: Considered sending cryptocurrency to a different address based solely on the sender's instructions.
prevention: Do not return funds to a different wallet address / Verify the transaction with the originating platform before taking action
